title: Token Economics Playbook — Cost Attribution & Export Patterns
creator: Ava Chen
description: Design a reusable Token Economics Playbook UI kit for the Redwood Console that standardizes token-level cost breakdowns, attribution views, and export workflows. The goal is a set of composable patterns that product and engineering can reuse across Dashboards, Billing exports, and Rollouts dashboards to enable fast diagnosis of per-token cost drivers and actionable pricing recommendations. This ticket delivers: 1) a primary cost-breakdown panel (token buckets, model variant, quantization, cache hit), 2) an attribution timeline (session-level and route-level aggregation), 3) CSV/JSON export mappings and preview, 4) pricing pattern components (rate-band sliders, cost-slab previews, SKU-aware labels), and 5) accessibility and performance constraints for large tenant datasets.
acceptance_criteria: High-fidelity Figma frames for desktop and responsive (<=1280px) showing cost-breakdown, attribution timeline, and export modal
Export schema documented with sample 100-row CSV and JSON payloads mapped to product fields
Design spec includes component-level tokens, interaction states, and empty/error states for slow queries
PM and Eng sign-off captured in review comments; two UX research microtests (n=6) completed showing task success >=80% for attribution lookup
Accessibility checklist passed: keyboard focus order, aria labels for charts, color contrast >=4.5:1 for key readability
updates: 2026-02-15: Ticket created — scope reviewed with PM (J. Morales) and Eng lead (S. Gupta). Agreed to prioritize export schema before finalizing UI to avoid rework.

2026-02-20: Exploratory sketches completed. Two variations: 1) stacked waterfall with dynamic drill-in, 2) tabular-first with embedded micro charts. Decided to prototype waterfall-first for quick visual attribution.
2026-02-28: Prototype (waterfall-first) built in Figma; early perf note: rendering >1M tokens across tenants is a bottleneck; added summary+sampling mode requirement.
2026-03-04: UX research microtests (6 participants) — users found rate-band slider helpful but requested explicit preview of resulting per-message price. Added cost-slab preview to pattern.
2026-03-08: Design critique with PM/Eng: suggested changes to CSV column ordering for easier join with billing ledger. Updated export schema accordingly.
2026-03-10: Submitted for final review. Attach PR and sample CSV. Requesting Eng acceptance and accessibility sign-off.
decisions: Adopt waterfall-first main view with an always-visible summary row to handle high-volume datasets (avoid rendering full rowset by default).
Provide two export modes: 'Full ledger' (all token events) and 'Summarized' (route/session aggregates) to satisfy both audit and analytics use cases.
Include a cost-slab preview tied to rate-band slider so customers can immediately see per-message and per-1000-token impacts.
Show cache-hit attribution as a separate micro-bar in the waterfall to avoid conflating kernel/quantization savings with cache effects.
tradeoffs: Rendering performance vs. fidelity: chose aggregated summaries by default with a user toggle to stream raw events for advanced customers — reduces CPU and memory pressure in-browser.
CSV first vs. API-first: prioritized CSV export for auditability and analyst workflows; API endpoint contract will be defined in a follow-up ENG ticket to avoid blocking design delivery.
Complexity of pricing UI vs. cognitive load: rate-band sliders are simpler than table-of-slabs for quick experimentation, but we preserve a detailed slab table in advanced mode.
review_feedback: PM (Jordan Morales): Move 'Export' button into the top-right persistent toolbar; add guardrail copy if export will trigger a long-running job.
Eng (Sanjay Gupta): Need explicit contract for export schema and a pagination/streaming plan for >100k rows; suggested adding sampling flags in the CSV header.
Security (Priya Verma): Confirm PII-free export by default; require opt-in for any raw prompt text. Added privacy note in export modal.
Design (Rosa Almeida): Visual hierarchy tweak — increase summary row weight and ensure timeline scrubber snaps to event boundaries.
export_schema_summary: fields: [timestamp, tenant_id, route, model_variant, batch_size, tokens_input, tokens_output, quantization, cache_hit, cost_usd, cost_basis, request_id]
csv_header_notes: include 'schema_version' and 'export_mode' in header rows; sampling_flag present when summarized mode used
json_export: nested arrays are avoided; each row is a flat map to keep analytics joins simple
qa_notes: QA should validate: export CSV column order matches documented schema; summarized mode aggregates match Datadog dashboard totals within a 1% tolerance
Verify keyboard-only navigation across export modal and timeline scrubber
Simulate large tenant export (100k rows) to ensure UI displays progress and respects server-side pagination hints
